text:
nate_sales: Heads-up — MicroGrid (reseller pilot) was invoiced full list rates last month; partner claims reseller discount should have applied. They want a retroactive adjustment and extended payment terms.

claire_revops: How big is the adjustment they're asking for?

nate_sales: They claim a 25% reseller discount on $95k usage for Feb, asking for $23,750 credit + Net60 instead of Net30 for partner cashflow.

anna_finance: 25% on $95k = $23,750. That's material. Did the partner register correctly in the portal? Any missing referral code?

nate_sales: Partner integration flow shows they used partner API key but missed partner onboarding step that auto-applies the discount. Logs attached to ticket PART-412.

leo_legal: If the partner failed to complete onboarding we normally don't backdate discounts. But this is strategic: reseller could bring ~1.2M ARR pipeline.

claire_revops: So it's a platform UX failure plus ambiguous onboarding messaging. We have some responsibility.

anna_finance: My discretionary limit for retrospective credits is $10k. Anything above needs CFO approval and an exception memo.

cfo_kim: @anna_finance per my policy: credits >$20k require CRO sign-off and a short business case. This one is borderline.

nate_sales: Partner is threatening to pause onboarding and escalate to their procurement. They want the full $23.75k credited or they pause deployments.

leo_legal: I recommend a compromise: approve $15k credit now, require partner to sign a reseller addendum that includes explicit discount mechanics and a 6-month minimum rev share commitment. Legal will draft.

claire_revops: Also suggest converting them to a prepaid partner voucher for next quarter to protect cash flow and avoid setting Net60 precedent.

anna_finance: Approve $15k one-time credit under these conditions: 1) signed reseller addendum within 5 business days, 2) conversion of the remaining disputed balance into a partner credit voucher applied to next invoice, 3) document exception in deal-exceptions ledger.

cfo_kim: I approve $15k with those conditions. Need the CRO on the addendum too, but legal can start draft.

leo_legal: Will draft addendum and exception memo; will tag deal-exceptions #DE-712. Recommend requiring partner to finish onboarding pipeline step to unlock future discounts.

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-MG-2026-02 for $15,000. Pending upload of signed addendum to apply full settlement.

nate_sales: I'll push partner to sign today. Appreciate fast turn here.

claire_revops: I'll schedule a post-mortem on the onboarding UX to prevent recurrence. Tagging product + devex.

billing-bot: Credit applied once addendum uploaded. Also flagged account to prevent auto Net60 unless approved by finance.

nate_sales: Partner signed addendum at 1812349000. Please apply credit and convert remainder to voucher.

billing-bot: Applied $15,000 credit and created voucher for remaining disputed amount. Updated invoice and ledger entry #DE-712. :white_check_mark:

anna_finance: Recording approval and closing thread. Documented exception and steps to remediate onboarding bug.

cfo_kim: Thanks team. Keep an eye on partner churn signals. Closing.
